channel.title: Bosses on Core Keeper Hub
channel.description: Recent content in Bosses on Core Keeper Hub

item.title: Azeos the Sky Titan
item.description: Azeos the Sky Titan is the fourth main boss, summoned in Azeos’ Wilderness. Its claw is required to progress past the wall. Strategy Dodge the dive-bomb — attack during landing recovery Scarlet-tier gear recommended

item.title: Ghorm the Devourer
item.description: Ghorm the Devourer is the second main boss, a giant worm that circles the world ring. Follow its track in the dirt ring and summon it with the Ghorm Summoning Idol. Strategy Ride the ring: chase it down in a straight line rather than waiting Its horn is required for progression

item.title: Glurch the Abominable Mass
item.description: Glurch the Abominable Mass is the first main boss, summoned at The Core or found in the first ring. Beating it unlocks the Glurch Eye required for progression and drops early metals. Strategy Early gear is fine — dodge its slam, attack after the shockwave Bring a Copper-tier weapon and food buffs

item.title: Hive Mother
item.description: The Hive Mother is the third main boss, deep inside the Larva Hive dungeon in the Clay Caves. Clear the hive to its arena at roughly 330 tiles. Strategy Iron gear recommended — its larva swarm hits from all sides Use the Hive Mother Scanner to locate the arena

item.title: Malugaz the Corrupted
item.description: Malugaz the Corrupted is an optional boss in the Forgotten Ruins, summoned at the Corrupted Core. It drops Malugaz’s Skull and a Corrupted Chest. Strategy Bring ranged options for its telegraphed attacks Optional but drops strong corrupted gear

item.title: Omoroth the Sea Titan
item.description: Omoroth the Sea Titan is the fifth main boss, summoned in The Sunken Sea. Its eye is required for progression. Strategy Fight in the water — plan escape routes before engaging Octarine-tier gear recommended

item.title: Ra-Akar the Sand Titan
item.description: Ra-Akar the Sand Titan is the sixth main boss, summoned in The Desert of Beginnings. Its wing is required for progression. Strategy Move between cover to avoid its ranged bursts Galaxite-tier gear recommended
